question: Add Broken Top South Peak South Ridge, and does South Peak need its own peak area?
answer: Route not verified. A 2011 ski report climbs the south/SW ridge from Todd Lake to the west (south) summit at almost 9,100 ft via a ~50 degree slope then a rock ridge; no class, no gendarmes. A 2024 blog mentions the south summit only as a backup peak, not visited. UO and Oregon Hikers pages list only NW Ridge and Nine OClock Couloir. Peakbagger and SummitPost South Peak pages gave 403, so Class 3 and the gendarmes are unconfirmed. South Peak (~9,100 ft) is a subsidiary summit of the 9,175 ft main peak.
recommendation: No separate peak area; if added, file as a route on or_broken_top. Prefer holding until a source states the class; the proposed row is the fallback if the owner accepts thin sourcing.

proposed.name: South Peak South Ridge
proposed.overview: A ridge route to the lower south summit of Broken Top, a separate high point a little below the main peak. It gains the ridge from the south side and follows loose scree and rock to the top. In early season it is a steep snow climb instead.
proposed.approach: Start from the Todd Lake side and head up to the base of the south ridge. Expect cross-country travel on open pumice and scree.
proposed.note: Class 3 comes from the stored candidate, not from any page I could open; verify before writing.
